meta.title: The empty-list message shows and nothing can be picked

plan.title: Empty assignee list for multiple PRs

steps.note: Enable the required PR team-filtering configuration for this case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area, the required starting screen for a PR-based flow.
Stay on the Open PR tab where the two test PRs can be selected.

args.goal: select one item from PR-1 and one item from PR-2, click the Assign person button next to Upload PRs, and stop with the Search a user list open showing the empty assignee result

steps.note: The catalog has no step for selecting items across two different PRs or opening this Assign flow, so perform those buyer-side actions in the current session.

args.text: No user can see all selected PRs. Assign them separately.

steps.note: Verify the required empty-list message is shown.
Verify that the assignee picker offers no selectable names, confirming nothing can be picked or assigned.
